metadata.author: SHR Drums contributors
metadata.source: Deterministic SHR Drums modeled synthesis; no recorded or downloaded audio

metadata.modification_notes: Rebuilt as 27 distinct modeled voices. Existing notes and voice IDs remain compatible. Voice-local click/body/noise/mode layers use deliberate bounded drive, clipping, modulation, deterministic variation, and stereo shaping before the protected kit ceiling.
